title: 16730 - 16730/P0346
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G163) faulty
Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G163) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G163)
Kontrol edin:  Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G163)
technicalNotes:
When found in the 3.2 FSI
Please see TPI 2012630 for information about Camshaft Adjusters binding.
If the camshaft adjuster is suspected you may be able to swap the left and right side components to see if the fault code moves (providing the parts are compatible).
On engines with chain driven intake camshaft(s), but belt driven exhaust camshaft(s), verify the number of chain roller links between the intake and exhaust camshafts is correct.  Click on thumbnail to enlarge:
